# pbs_notification_targets (Data Source)

Lists the notification endpoints of a Proxmox Backup Server, of every type, the built-in `mail-to-root` included: what a `pbs_notification_matcher` may name in `target`. Reading them needs `Sys.Audit on /system/notifications`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every notification endpoint, of every type, and the enabled ones by name.
data "pbs_notification_targets" "all" {}

output "enabled_notification_targets" {
  value = [for t in data.pbs_notification_targets.all.targets : t.name if !t.disable]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `targets` (Attributes List) The endpoints, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets))

<a id="nestedatt--targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `targets`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) The endpoint's comment; null when there is none.
- `disable` (Boolean) Whether the endpoint is disabled.
- `name` (String) Endpoint name.
- `origin` (String) Where the endpoint comes from: `user-created`, `builtin` or `modified-builtin`.
- `type` (String) Endpoint type: `sendmail`, `smtp`, `gotify` or `webhook`.
